source_inventory.span: We use well-established results in biological vision to construct a novel vision model for handwritten digit recognition.
We show empirically that the features extracted by our model are linearly separable over a large training set (MNIST).
Using only a linear classifier on these features, our model is relatively simple yet outperforms other models on the same data set.
